newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Guangdong H1 foreign trade tops $57.68 bln.
newsitem.headline: China's Guangdong H1 foreign trade tops $57.68 bln.

text.p: Trade by China's booming southern province of Guangdong reached $57.68 billion in the first half of this year, up 21.6 percent from the year-ago period, the International Business Daily said on Wednesday.
Exports totalled $33.3 billion, up 32.7 percent compared with the first half of 1996, while imports rose by 9.1 percent to $24.38 billion, the newspaper said.
The trade surplus reached $8.92 billion, it said.

Of the total, trade by state-owned enterprises totalled $25.16 billion, up 28.7 percent from a year ago, while trade by foreign-funded firms rose 16.4 percent to $30.77 billion, it said without giving further details.
